description: Use this when the user wants to compare paint colors on the walls of the same room. It returns a nine-color comparison. Color preferences are optional; use RoomLab’s balanced default palette when the user did not specify colors.

additional_instructions.description: Optional user preferences stated in natural language. Do not ask for this when the request is already clear.

colors.description: Optional nine paint colors in grid order. Omit to use the same nine defaults shown in the workspace.

image.description: The room image attached by the user. Do not ask the user for file metadata.

download_url.description: A temporary HTTPS download URL supplied by the host. Never construct this from a local path.

anyOf.description: A complete data:image/jpeg, data:image/png, or data:image/webp base64 URI supplied by the client.

data.description: The existing base64 image bytes. Pass them unchanged; do not regenerate or summarize them.
